verdict.rationale: Klaviyo ships an official MCP server, remote-hosted or local, that connects AI agents like Claude or Cursor to account data and supports tasks up to flow performance reports. It is also explicitly headless, so agents can read Klaviyo data through public APIs, and the docs position the API for pulling data into dashboards and performance analysis, with scoped keys and paginated reads. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of reading audiences (lists/segments) and campaign-results reporting endpoints via the API or MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent assembling a whole-program report.
